friction.problem: Help says it promotes an inbox note into a drawer candidate but does not state that the source inbox note file is deleted as a side effect.
friction.how_resolved: Observed actual behavior (source file deleted) and proceeded.

friction.problem: There is no CLI surface to list or inspect deferred drawer candidates (no 'list drawer(s)'/'drawer' subcommand), so drawer work can only be discovered by reading the filesystem.
The requested end state 'leave the task open' has no literal 'open' status; the CLI creates the task as 'draft' and the drawer file is kept for manual cleanup by design.
friction.how_resolved: Left the task at non-closed status 'draft' and kept the drawer file (CLI default) rather than guessing a cleanup policy.
